related: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/55947
## The purpose of this PR:
Mask sensitive values in cli
The sensitive values are:
```
secret_key
jwt_secret
asset_manager_kwargs
fernet_key
sql_alchemy_conn
sql_alchemy_conn_async
sql_alchemy_engine_args
remote_task_handler_kwargs
backend_kwargs
sentry_dsn
secret_key
secrets_backend_kwargs
```
### What this PR changed:
- ~Add two parameter `hide_sensitive_values`, and `is_sensitive` in `def _write_value`~
- ~Add logic to check if the value is sensitive. If it is, print the value as "< hidden >", if not, print the original value.~
- Add `hide_sensitive`, `show_values`, and `is_sensitive` to `_write_value()`
- Update `_write_value` so that it print keys by default, and print values(including sensitive values) only when `show_values` is specified.
- Allow `hide_sensitive` to be used together with `show_values` to display values while masking sensitive information.
